name: reviews-by-source
title: Reviews by source
description: Review cards with stars, title, date and reviewer, filtered by where they were written, with the average and count for each source.
docs: Pass reviews ({ id, source, rating, title, body, author, date }) and sources ({ name, average, count, href? }) in tab order. The summary under the tabs uses each source's own average and count, and for All the weighted average of them; it is a polite live region. A rating is read as 'Rated 4.5 out of 5' and drawn to the half star. href adds 'Read all on {source}'. value, defaultValue ('all' or a source's name) and onValueChange control the tab. locale and timeZone format numbers and dates; labels translate every fixed word (templates use {average}, {count}, {reviews}, {source}, {rating} and {max}). Source names are text, never logos.
